_comment: This file is for CLAUDE CODE developers working on this repo, pointing at the local dev build. For END USERS who installed via Homebrew or the DMG: the simplest registration is `claude mcp add maccrab -- "$(which maccrab-mcp)"`. To edit config by hand, Claude Code reads ~/.claude.json (NOT ~/.claude/settings.json) and Claude Desktop on macOS reads ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (NOT ~/.config/Claude/...); set `command` to the absolute path printed by `which maccrab-mcp` (typically /opt/homebrew/bin/maccrab-mcp on Apple Silicon, /usr/local/bin/maccrab-mcp on Intel).

maccrab.description: MacCrab threat detection engine — query alerts, events, campaigns, security score, and hunt threats
